title: Sharks Live Inside This Active Underwater Volcano

scenes.text: Sharks are living inside an active underwater volcano.
It's called Kavachi, in the Pacific near the Solomon Islands. It erupts again and again.
The water is too hot and too acidic for human divers, so scientists sent down cameras and disposable robots.
Inside the crater, the cameras filmed hammerhead sharks and silky sharks.
They even spotted a stingray in the volcano's ash plume.
Sharks, inside a volcano. That's Kavachi.

description:
Scientists found hammerhead and silky sharks living inside the crater of Kavachi, an active underwater volcano near the Solomon Islands.
The water is too hot and acidic for divers, so they used disposable robots and cameras.
Would you go down there?
first_comment: Hammerhead or silky shark: which would you rather see up close?
